items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: just as good as Snook and Russell

ctx.x: So you didn't, when you were, it seemed like you were almost self-taught in a way, from

years ago. Well, my dad, man, my dad was a hell of a piano player, man, but he'd rather work on a riverfront than a, he had a natural talent. And when he go to the house party, he'd upset the party, man. He and two other guys, they'd go around and they'd go to house parties and they'd be piano players at that time, way back then, man. They were very popular, because they didn't have artophones and they didn't have the stuff that we have today. And everything was just beautiful, man. And he showed me some seventh…
But it's some kind of, it's a prelude. I can't think of it. I'll call you up and tell you what
